# Step 2.253: an archived league's box score page is still viewable (T-519)

## What exists

- `packages/core/src/modules/games/policy.ts`: `mayViewScoring` and `mayViewChanges` (the same role checks as `mayScoreGame` and `mayChangeGames`, in any state of the league) and `readOnlyStateOf`. Every change still asks the old checks.
- `games.get_box_score_sheet` is open in an archived or suspended league to whoever could open it before; its `locked` is then `archived` or `suspended` (before every other lock), and `mayReopen`, `mayCorrect`, `mayCallOff` are false.
- `games.read_game_format` (`mayViewFormat`) answers there with `change: { may: false, reason: 'league-read-only' }` (new in `gameFormatRefusals` and the reply's enum, status 409); the format panel says one line (`tracker.format.leagueReadOnly`).
- `games.read_tracked_box_score` answers there with `notCorrectable: 'league-read-only'`; the tracked grid page already draws a closed grid with that line.
- The box score page: the sheet with every box disabled, no save, no reopen or put back, and the line "This league is archived, so its games can be viewed but not changed." (`admin.boxScore.locked.archived`, `.suspended`). A called-off game is now told by the game's own status, so it keeps its "no box score" page there. The own-result offer is not read in a read-only league.
- Role matrix (`packages/database/src/stores/role-matrix.test.ts`): three rows moved from `changeToolReads` (refused) to a new `viewReads` set (expected "ok" in an archived and a suspended league): `games.get_box_score_sheet`, `games.read_game_format`, `games.read_tracked_box_score`. No other row changed.
- Left refused on purpose (T-501 stands for them): the reopen, own-result and put-back offers, the tracker's state and rosters, `leagues.preview_season_rules` (it previews a change that is refused) and `standings.list_adjustments` (its answer is mostly the offers the standings page's add, remove, coin-flip and overturn forms are built on; opening it needs that page, outside this lane's folders, to hide them: a follow-up step).
- T-519 in `docs/specs/v1/decisions-pending/T-519.md` and a bullet in T4 section 4. Pinned row count in `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` unchanged.
- New browser test `tests/browser/archived-box-score-test.mjs`: the owner opens an Old Meadow game from Earlier games, and gets the sheet, the line, no save, no reopen, all boxes disabled, accessible, no sideways scroll.

## Run and passed

- `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`; `node --test tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` (11 passed).
- vitest: core modules, contracts, game-format, games-area, tracker, messages, archived-season guards (317 files, 3294 tests); the six database and server test files that use these reads (243); the role matrix (860, 290 s).
- `node scripts/run-web-browser-tests.mjs archived-box-score-test` (8 checks).
- Broken by hand and seen to fail: the sheet refused again in a read-only league (the new core test, the matrix rows, the browser test: 404); the format's reason turned back to `no-permission` (the new format test).

## What I distrust

- The browser test types the game's address after reading its id from the list (the games list may not link a game in an archived league); the whole browser chain was not run.
- A tracked game in a read-only league shows its saved lines on the sheet, with no link to the tracked grid (the box score page reads the grid only for `locked: 'tracked'`).
